pattern.description: End-card lockup: the workday letters wipe in left to right with small coloured strokes resolving into blue glyphs, 'Adaptive Planning' fades up from pale to brand blue beneath, then the orange arc sweeps on over the wordmark.
pattern.why_premium: Sequenced build (wordmark, descriptor, then signature arc last) makes the brand mark the final beat, with the arc as a distinct payoff rather than the logo just appearing.

build_hint.gsap: tl.fromTo('.wd-letter', {clipPath: 'inset(0 100% 0 0)', color: '#3fa9f5'}, {clipPath: 'inset(0 0% 0 0)', color: '#0b4ea2', stagger: 0.05, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.out'}).fromTo('.ap-name', {autoAlpha: 0}, {autoAlpha: 1, duration: 0.4, ease: 'power1.out'}, '<0.1').fromTo('.arc path', {drawSVG: '50% 50%'}, {drawSVG: '0% 100%', duration: 0.4, ease: 'power2.out'}, '>-0.05')
build_hint.remotion: Per-letter clip progress = interpolate(frame - i*1.5, [0, 9], [0, 1], {easing: Easing.out(Easing.cubic)}); name opacity interpolate over 12 frames; arc strokeDashoffset from full to 0 over 12 frames after the letters, ease-out, no spring overshoot.

notes: Exact letter reveal mechanism (mask wipe vs coloured strokes morphing into glyphs) is hard to tell from the filmstrip; arc may grow outward from its centre top rather than draw end to end. Slight overall scale change (1.018) is probably a gentle lockup settle, not a camera move.
